content: Level One, the exotericists (ahl-i ẓāhir), are the traditionists who transmit the Prophetic words and preserve their literal forms, relying on imitation (taqlīd). They insist on taking the splitting of the moon literally, reject inquiry into how it happened as reprehensible innovation, and allow no further meaning of the verse. Ibn Turka adds that this is the position of the majority of the common people and that God's wisdom has confined their thought to this level.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
